name: Release qualification
description: Qualify a repository release through static checks, deterministic contracts, native integration, behavioral evaluation, and an evidence report.

states.description: Parse and validate canonical sources, schemas, paths, models, permissions, and generated metadata.
states.stopCondition: Stop when any required static validation fails.

states.description: Run deterministic contract, graph, containment, ownership, and idempotency tests against disposable roots.
states.stopCondition: Stop when a required deterministic contract is failing or flaky.

states.description: Run available native integration checks on clean disposable profiles and document unavailable products or platforms.
states.stopCondition: Stop when a required available native integration check fails; mark unavailable checks not run.

states.description: Run repeated fresh-context behavioral evaluations with fixed cases, controls, and scoring.
states.stopCondition: Stop when behavioral samples are not reproducible, comparable, or within the approved gate.

states.description: Write the release evidence, limitations, not-run checks, findings, and qualification decision.
states.stopCondition: Stop successfully only when the qualification decision is supported by evidence and limitations are explicit.

gates.requirement: All required static sources and schemas validate.
Required deterministic contracts pass without flakiness.
Available native checks pass and unavailable checks are explicit not run.
Repeated behavioral evidence meets the approved release thresholds.
Evidence, limitations, findings, and the decision are durable.

successCriteria: Static, deterministic, native, and behavioral gates have recorded evidence.
The release decision states every limitation and not-run check without fabricated qualification.
